entities.name: Henrika Domnathi
entities.description: Founder of the Domnathi vampire bloodline on Innistrad and leader of its surviving members, known as the Infernal Seer.

entities.name: Domnathi
entities.description: Vampire bloodline that makes pacts with demons.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: Demon Henrika is rumored to have been romantically involved with.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: Vampire who made a pact with the human factions and later invited Henrika to her wedding.

entities.name: Commander Odric
entities.description: Turned into a vampire by Henrika.

entities.name: Ormendahl
entities.description: Demon for whom Henrika sought to raise cathar warriors.

entities.name: Relio Voldaren
entities.description: Killed by Henrika after an insult at the wedding.

events.summary: After the Travails began, Henrika refuses to honor Olivia's pact with the human factions.
events.quote: Henrika refused to honor the pact that Olivia Voldaren had made with the human factions

events.summary: Henrika turns Commander Odric into a vampire, subverting his loyalty.
events.quote: successfully turned Commander Odric into a vampire

events.summary: At Olivia and Edgar's wedding, Henrika kills Relio Voldaren after an insult.
events.quote: ending his life on the spot
